notes.title: Patch 1.2.5 has gone live.
notes.content:
Dear Fans,

Thank you for playing Croixleur Sigma - Deluxe Edition.

This message is to inform you that a new update has gone live.
The following has been added in this patch.

[list]
[*] Added feature that allows you to exit game from the main menu.
[/list]

Again, thank you for your continued support.

tags.feature: [*] Added feature that allows you to exit game from the main menu.
